<a id="extrapolation-by-elimination--逐除外推"></a>
# Extrapolation by elimination

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`learning-by-refutation` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F11 · [record](learning-by-refutation.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Given a map moving every value, every extrapolation has an open course on which each proposal misses; no prefix fixes the next value. In a world held by a list, elimination misses boundedly often, its rest, unrefuted, occurs only there, and no prefix shows when; over classes it is the same learning.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A course is a sequence of values; its prefix before step t lists its t values before t, latest first, and depends only on them. An extrapolation is any map from a prefix to a proposed value or silence; a proposal misses a value where a value is proposed and the value that comes differs; an extrapolation accords with a course where it misses at no step. (`Becoming.Learning.prefixOf`, `Becoming.Learning.prefix_length`, `Becoming.Learning.prefix_congr`, `Becoming.Learning.Misses`, `Becoming.Learning.MissesAt`, `Becoming.Learning.Accords`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
2. For every extrapolation, course and step t, and two different values: the courses that keep the course before t and hold one value or the other from t on share its prefix before t, and a value proposed from that prefix is not right on both; with equality of values decided, it misses on one of them. (`Becoming.Learning.holdFrom`, `Becoming.Learning.no_prefix_fixes_next`, `Becoming.Learning.claim_missed_on_one`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
3. A course repeats from step i with period q + 1 where its values at u + q + 1 and at u agree for every u ≥ i. For every extrapolation, course, step t and two different values, the two courses held at one value or the other from t on repeat from t with period 1, share the prefix before t, and a value proposed from it is not right on both. (`Becoming.Learning.Lasso`, `Becoming.Learning.holdFrom_lasso`, `Becoming.Learning.no_prefix_fixes_next_finite`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
4. For every extrapolation and every map moving each value, the diagonal course, the latest value of the orbit of the law that adds to the prefix the value set against each proposal, makes each value proposed miss at its step, so there is no step from which on the extrapolation proposes the coming value at every step; whatever the map, no list holds that law's configurations. (`Becoming.Learning.answerTo`, `Becoming.Learning.answerStep`, `Becoming.Learning.diagonal`, `Becoming.Learning.prefix_diagonal`, `Becoming.Learning.diagonal_misses`, `Becoming.Learning.diagonal_unrested`, `Becoming.Learning.diagonal_open`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* finite runs; its declarations do not reach the grammar.
5. With two different values x and y and equality of values decided, the map sending x to y and every other value to x moves every value. (`Becoming.Learning.swapTo`, `Becoming.Learning.swapTo_moves`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
6. With equality of values decided, extrapolation by elimination over candidates H takes them in order, moving to the next exactly where the current one misses, and proposes the current one's value. Where candidate j accords with a course, the current candidate never passes j, so it misses at most j times, and it is not the case that it misses at arbitrarily late steps. (`Becoming.Learning.indexOn`, `Becoming.Learning.byElimination`, `Becoming.Learning.index`, `Becoming.Learning.index_le_of_accords`, `Becoming.Learning.misses_not_recurring`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
7. With equality of values decided, under elimination over any candidates on any course, every candidate passed before step t missed, while current, at some earlier step; two courses with the same prefix before t give the same current candidate and the same proposed value at t. (`Becoming.Learning.missed_before`, `Becoming.Learning.byElimination_through_prefix`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
8. Under a determined law whose orbit is held by a list l, the orbit read through any map repeats from some step i with some period q + 1, i + q + 1 at most the length of l; every course repeating from i with period q + 1 is the course, read through it, of the law on positions 0 to i + q stepping each to the next and the last to i, held by the list of its positions. (`Becoming.Learning.lasso_of_held`, `Becoming.Learning.lassoNext`, `Becoming.Learning.lasso_realized`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure and finite runs; its declarations reach the grammar.
9. The lasso candidate (i, q) proposes, from step i + q + 1 on, the value q + 1 steps back, and is silent before; it accords with every course repeating from i with period q + 1. In the diagonal order of pairs, (i, q) stands at place tri (i + q) + q, tri being the triangular numbers. (`Becoming.Learning.lasso`, `Becoming.Learning.lasso_accords`, `Becoming.Learning.pairAt`, `Becoming.Learning.tri`, `Becoming.Learning.pairAt_place`, `Becoming.Learning.lassos`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
10. With equality of values decided, on a course repeating from i with period q + 1, elimination over the lasso candidates in diagonal order, given neither i nor q, misses at most tri (i + q) + q times, proposes at every step from i + q + 1 on, and it is not the case that it misses at arbitrarily late steps; that from some step on it proposes and is right is not refuted. (`Becoming.Learning.lasso_byElimination_bounded`, `Becoming.Learning.rest_unrefuted`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
11. With equality of values decided, where elimination over the lasso candidates proposes the coming value at every step from some step on, the course repeats from some step with some period; for any map moving each value, its own diagonal course repeats from no step with any period. (`Becoming.Learning.lasso_of_rest`, `Becoming.Learning.diagonal_not_lasso`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
12. With equality of values decided, under a determined law whose orbit is held by a list l, read through any map: elimination over the lasso candidates misses fewer than tri (length of l) times, proposes at every step from the length of l on, and it is not the case that it misses at arbitrarily late steps; that it comes to rest is not refuted. (`Becoming.Learning.held_byElimination_bounded`, `Becoming.Learning.held_rest_unrefuted`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure and finite runs; its declarations reach the grammar.
13. A sequence of natural numbers that never falls and stays within a bound K is not refuted to be constant from some step on. (`Becoming.Learning.stable_unrefuted`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
14. With equality of values decided, for classes of candidates G c merged along the pairs into one enumeration: where candidate j of class c accords with a course, elimination over the merged enumeration never passes place tri (c + j) + j; for any map moving each value, on its own diagonal course there is no step from which on it proposes the coming value at every step. (`Becoming.Learning.merged`, `Becoming.Learning.merged_bound`, `Becoming.Learning.merged_unrested`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
15. On the alternating course false, true, false, …, which repeats from step 0 with period 2, elimination over the lasso candidates has missed twice by step 3 and from step 3 on proposes the coming value at every step. (`Becoming.Learning.Alternate.course`, `Becoming.Learning.Alternate.repeats`, `Becoming.Learning.Alternate.index_three`, `Becoming.Learning.Alternate.rests`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. Decidable equality of values (DecidableEq O) appears only as a condition of the extrapolation (by elimination, over the lasso candidates, over merged classes, and diagonal_not_lasso) and of swapTo (another value).
- Beyond the definitions that take it, decided equality of values enters only the proofs of claim_missed_on_one, eq_of_not_missed, swapTo_moves, index_succ_le, index_le_succ and missed_before; no_prefix_fixes_next, diagonal_misses, diagonal_unrested and diagonal_open do not use it.
- Each theorem's conditions are written into it: two different values (no_prefix_fixes_next); other moving every value (the diagonal); some candidate according (index_le_of_accords, misses_not_recurring); the course being a lasso or the orbit held by a list (lasso_byElimination_bounded, held_byElimination_bounded).
- The candidates H and the classes G are supplied from outside the learning.
- Coming to rest is stated only as a double negation (rest_unrefuted, held_rest_unrefuted, stable_unrefuted), the names carrying “unrefuted”: the step of rest is not stated here, and is not shown impossible.
- Becoming.Identification states that step: where the orbit is held by a list of length N, the extrapolation proposes and is right at every step from N + (2N − 1)·tri N on (Identification.held_byElimination_rests), a step the bound gives and the extrapolation's prefix does not show.
- “Not missing at arbitrarily late steps” is the negation of misses recurring, not “no miss from some step on”.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Which candidates or classes an actual formation holds, whether its values through a map are decided and whether its world is held by a list do not follow.
- The bound tri N is not shown to be the least: it is a coarse bound.
- Only determined, value-by-value learning is stated: probabilistic or approximate learning (PAC), the general theory of countable classes and computational complexity lie outside it.
- **Counterexample:** No extrapolation rests on every course: the diagonal course makes each value it proposes miss (diagonal_unrested), and the lasso extrapolation's diagonal course is no lasso (diagonal_not_lasso). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Learning.lean)

<details><summary>Correspondence, dependencies, sources and history</summary>

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

On 12 October 2026 Ren asked how completely the meta level, artificial neural networks, cognition and the wisdom about learning are explained; to the AI's answer (none complete, induction undissolved) Ren replied “please, fully complete, 我觉得理更像是对结构和变化的规律的建模 finish wisdom root, and resolve the undissolved”. The AI reads it as completing the three proposed steps and resolving the problem of induction. Readings (AI readings): induction is resolved into laws rather than certified; Hume's problem sits at no_prefix_fixes_next; extrapolation by elimination is identification in the limit in Gold's sense, its rest not showing; the meta level is learning again, with no top (the reading of merged_unrested); wisdom is never a completed extrapolation. The main theorems are known results of learning theory in the spine's form: Putnam's diagonal (1963), identification in the limit after Gold (1967) and Putnam (1965), Gold's enumeration method, and the reading of induction as convergence without certainty after Kelly (1996); the spine's own part is their integration with coupling, experiment, mechanism and selection.

<a id="dependencies--依赖"></a>
### Dependencies

- **formal-reuse**: [recurrence-without-premise](recurrence-without-premise.md). Reuses Law.orbit, Law.process, revisits_within (within finitely many configurations the orbit returns), unlisted_of_new (a law new at every step is held by no list), gap_of_le, gap_of_lt and mem_cons_cases. The delta reads return off the course through a map: the course through a map of an orbit held by a list is a lasso, and the course of a law keeping its whole prefix is the diagonal course.
  - Output: Within finitely many configurations the orbit returns; a law new at every step is held by no list.
  - Input: The course through a map of a world held by a list is a lasso; the diagonal course's world is open.
  - Preserved conditions: No premise; a determined law. [Recurrence.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Recurrence.lean)
- **interpretive**: [testing-within-couplings](testing-within-couplings.md). P49's Web.tail_unexcluded (without a model no finite prefix excludes a claim about what follows) is the same law for level histories; here it is stated for every course (no_prefix_fixes_next), with its positive side: in a world held by a list extrapolation by elimination misses a bounded number of times.
  - Output: A claim is excluded only through a difference in what couples in; without a model the prefix excludes no claim about what follows.
  - Input: Misses and learning on a course.
  - Preserved conditions: Values through the map that can be told apart (for extrapolation by elimination). [Testing.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Testing.lean)
- related, not a proved adapter: [experiment-needs-return](experiment-needs-return.md). There the record fixes an act's outcome only where taken; here the prefix fixes no next value, and a lasso's return is the return that lets learning come to rest.
- related, not a proved adapter: [generalization-through-lumping](generalization-through-lumping.md). There, when a model of what is irrelevant is right; here, when learning that selects a model from the prefix comes to rest.
- related, not a proved adapter: [scientific-inquiry-foundation](scientific-inquiry-foundation.md). The laws of induction are part of the necessary relations of scientific inquiry; this record does not prove the whole core indispensable to science.
- related, not a proved adapter: [learnable-through-a-map](learnable-through-a-map.md). Where the map does not tell configurations apart: some extrapolation rests at every configuration exactly where configurations with the same future through the map have features agreeing from some step on; the extrapolation still tells the values through the map apart.
